name: invoiceflow-landing-page
description: A clean, minimal landing page for InvoiceFlow - SaaS solution for small business invoice management

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:html && npm run build:assets
scripts.build:assets: shx mkdir -p dist/images dist/fonts && shx cp -r src/images/* dist/images/ 2>/dev/null || true && shx cp -r src/fonts/* dist/fonts/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.validate: npm run lint:html && npm run lint:css
